_note: Numbers of the earlier fine-tuned phase. 'verified_here': false everywhere: nothing in this file was re-run for this repository. Raw files are named per entry; 'offline' means the raw files are on a machine that was not reachable while this repository was assembled.

eyes.setup: Qwen2.5-0.5B fine-tuned (lr 1e-5, 3 epochs) on questions about 3-4 pasted MNIST digits (14x14, one token per pixel); with implants = eyes (trained CNN inside) + calculator, box tokens masked from the loss; without = same data, the model writes the digits itself

seed0.source: lab notebook / earlier blog draft table (raw files offline)
seed0.note: 8 and 32 rows: 200-question set; 4,000 and 16,000 rows: separate test set; MNIST test images throughout

five_seed_mean_no_implants.source: computed here: mean of seed 0 (93.4 / 97.4, from the earlier draft table, raw files offline) and seeds 1-4 (eyes.txt test split)

finetune_comparison.setup: Qwen2.5-0.5B fine-tuned on GSM8K (+ augmentation) three ways: plain solutions / calls where the model writes the result itself / calls answered by the calculator implant (result masked from the loss)

seed0.source: lab notebook, 'Final calculator model' table (raw files offline)

five_seed_mean_std.source: blog figure script ft_fig.py (raw per-seed files offline)
